name: WhatsappJoinCard - Default
description: The How to join card on its own, with the live form and admissions-criteria links. It is the site's standard card: white, a hairline border and a crimson left rule. The sentence ends with how long joining takes (under 3 minutes), the criteria link sits under it, and the larger Apply to join the community button closes the card. Under the button, in small grey type, a tip says that if the invite link won't open in WhatsApp on a Mac, it can be opened on a phone instead.
